property: A canonical re-bind, a replacing one included, is never admitted on fewer than the charter's M holder signatures.
An expired deferral re-routes only to another live seat the party conferred and, with none, to the conferrer.
Every dimension the text names resolves to a registered leaf, so no section relies on a row the home refuses.
Content is never withheld at read on a notice that an admitted lift has undone.
A moderator's act is lifted exactly when a strict majority of the roster as it stood at the act has objected inside the window.
A moderation row is admitted only from a named moderator of the content's community or its chain, never from the content's subject as such.
A slashing row is admitted only from a slash duty-holder or its chain, and no door depends on a quorum it cannot test.
No single key takes a member's key off a roster, an AI agent's key included, unless the removal rule names that exception.
The person a moderation record names is always served its existence, its kind, what follows and who answers for it.
A moderation row with no subject digest is admitted, and only a malformed digest is refused.
A room locks only when no live holder of moderate remains, never on the lapse of one edge among several.
Every scope token a signer rule cites is one of the eight pinned infra tokens.
A regime row is admitted only from the substrate steward.
An expired consent state is admitted only from the substrate and never from the subject or the owner.
A system row from either substrate role, persist or edge, is admitted.
A room's removal of a member is carried by exactly one count, and a room that declared unanimity is not overridden by two thirds.
An accord roster change counts the participations cast inside its window and none after.
A resume that names a halt other than the active one, or repeats an invocation id, never resumes.
A key grant for a blob is signed only by a key that speaks for the blob's owner, never by an admitting host for other members' blobs.
No write after a removal is sealed under a key the removed member was granted.
An ordinary widening on a live roster is admitted without the recovery condition, which binds only the one widening on a stalled roster.
After any departure, at any scope, later content is sealed under a key the departed member cannot derive.
The inviter alone withdraws their own pending proposal.
A deletion commitment carried in the envelope member is watched exactly as one carried in a row.
A node-authored community trust grant is counted in the fold for its attested key.
A consent state row from a proxy in the subject's delegation chain is admitted.
The seat is the same under every arrival order of ballots and seating rows.
The acceptance edge is the owner's row, and every node and agent the owner holds reads it.
The passing of the attach window never moves a rooted node.
A self-declared adult row never meets the guardian floor, and the guardianship of the named child is verified.
Adult content opens only to the adult band at a verified level, never on a self-declared one.
Every withdrawal another section admits matches a line of the closed admission table.
An owner can always end witnessing by withdrawing the acceptance.
The inviter alone withdraws their own pending proposal.
A row carrying a scrub set, a charter included, is withdrawn only by its quorum.
A group-declared goal, and each replacement or withdrawal of it, is admitted only when its scrub set meets the group's protocol.
One holder sets only relief that lapses at its term, and a durable setting needs the quorum.
A delivery receipt whose chunk root is no published head of its stream is refused.
A grant with no valid_until lapses by a clock only under the temporary bundle, and a partnered one never does.
A time-boxed seat, occurrence or pending binding is not live after its valid_until.
A standing proposal seats each key at most once and is not spent by its first joiner.
Every required body member of a family is in the signed object of the same edition.
A key holding a reserved role with no live conferral under a trusted root emits nothing that is admitted.
An occurrence citing a provenance row that is absent, not Rooted or of another manifest hash is refused.
The agent's own custody rung before retired needs no cosign, and a replacement after retired needs both signers.
The agent's own custody rung before retired needs no cosign, and a replacement after retired needs both signers.
A partnership grant is admitted only from the granting user with the partner as its one subject, and from no chain.
A takedown notice is admitted from the content's signed subject, a named takedown holder, or the owner of the detecting node on a hash match.
The shortest provisional tier opens on a provider rung with the adjudicated binding, and every continuing power needs the panel.
A halt never moves the validity of a root, a key or a conferral.
After a subject's withdrawal the producer is in breach at the window's close unless one of the producer's own composers stands.
A halt row a holder signed reaches exactly one verdict when its date is ahead of the node's clock, and a future date buys no longer pause.
Every ground another section sends to a verdict is an admitted ground of a slashing row.
A row at a targeted scope names only keys within its audience, so a licence shown to outside readers neither is refused nor hands them standing to withdraw it.
A non-member is served a public room's content on asking a member's node.
A roster row is never served outside its cohort, a public room's included.
A community has one live listing, and the set of keys that may replace it is the same in every section.
A key acts on content only while it holds the matching duty over the target, a named steward included.
Every outcome of the ladder is either a row some key may sign or a verdict each node derives, and none needs a row the door refuses.
A granted consent state is admitted only from a subject of the target, so a viewer's acknowledgement is never that row.
A takedown notice is admitted from the content's signed subject, a named takedown holder, or the owner of the detecting node on a hash match.
A hard_case row from a key that is not the substrate is refused.
A reserved family is closed to unnamed leaves only where the Part names its leaves.
Turning keep on wraps the current epoch and later ones, and turning it off stops from the next.
With two or more live keys an addition lands only by strict majority or after the delay, never on one voucher at once.
A granted consent state is admitted only from a subject of the target, so a viewer's acknowledgement is never that row.
A partnership grant is admitted only from the granting user with the partner as its one subject, and from no chain.
A hop key equal to any other key on the same signed row, the content encryption halves included, is refused.
A revocation of a key by another key with authority over it is admitted, and a key's own revocation is one case of it.
The evaluation opens only on the one stated trigger and never on the Stewardship Tier or a sector.
A person's own declaration never raises the band and lowers it even against a witness row.
A halt binds a node holding a live edge at the instant its store admits the row and latches, whatever the signed date says.
A node rooted under a head whose witnesses cease to be independent reaches exactly one standing.
An entity revocation is withdrawn by nobody, its issuer included.
A withdrawal of a statement about an affiliation, signed by that affiliation as subject, is refused.
A new accord roster verifies by one stated set of signatures, the votes or the list's own.
A one-voice body's removal, quarantine, slash or takedown against a member is admitted only with a countersign from outside the deciding seat.
Every duty-carrying edge has a term of at most 365 days in any group, not in affiliations alone.
